lines.text: Lazarus is sick in Bethany, the village of Mary and Martha, so the sisters send word to Jesus.
Jesus says the sickness is for God's glory, and He stays where He is for three days.
Jesus tells the disciples to go back to Judea, and they remind Him the Jews just tried to stone Him.
Jesus says Lazarus has fallen asleep and He will wake him, but the disciples think He means actual sleep.
Jesus says He is glad He was not there so they may believe, and Peter says, let us also go and die with Him.
